lines: The flu is caused by a virus.
The flu virus spreads when sick people cough or sneeze.
Then it goes into your body through the mouth or nose.
When you get the flu, you feel sick for a week or two.
You have a headache, a sore throat, and a fever.
Your muscles hurt, and you have chills.
What should you do to treat the flu?
Stay at home and rest in bed.
Take medicine to treat your sickness.
What do you do to avoid getting the flu?
And get a flu vaccine before winter comes.
body.text: The flu is caused by a virus. The flu virus spreads when sick people cough or sneeze. Then it goes into your body through the mouth or nose. When you get the flu, you feel sick for a week or two. You have a headache, a sore throat, and a fever. You feel tired and weak. Your muscles hurt, and you have chills. What should you do to treat the flu? Stay at home and rest in bed. Drink lots of water. Take medicine to treat your sickness. What do you do to avoid getting the flu? Wash your hands often. Don't share drinks with friends. And get a flu vaccine before winter comes.
